messages:
maria (Docs): Hey team — PR ready for the March changelog + migration guide. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 Can someone glance at the SDK snippets (JS + Go) and the 'Known issues' blurb for Dedicated streaming?

aj (DevEx): On it. Quick note: the JS snippet currently uses `client.generate()` which we changed to `client.text.generate()` last quarter. I can push a tiny PR to fix if you want.

noah (SDK): Yep, saw that. Also the Go example uses the old Embeddings API shape — needs the new `CreateEmbedding` call signature. I'll paste a corrected snippet in a sec.

maria (Docs): Thanks. Also: Product asked we mention the fallback model behavior in the changelog (when Dedicated capacity is exhausted). Sophia, do you have a 1-liner we can include?

sophia (Product): Sure: "If Dedicated capacity is unavailable, requests will automatically fall back to a compatible hosted model; clients will receive a 200 with a header X-Redwood-Fallback indicating fallback-model." Keep it short.

noah (SDK): Snippet (Go) — replace the old call with this:

```go
resp, err := client.CreateEmbedding(ctx, &inference.CreateEmbeddingRequest{
    Model: "open-embedding-1",
    Input: []string{"redwood inference"},
})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Data[0].Embedding)
```

aj (DevEx): For JS, suggest this minimal replacement so it matches the SDK surface used in our examples:

```js
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "open-embedding-1",
  input: ["redwood inference"],
})
console.log(resp.data[0].embedding)
```

maria (Docs): Perfect. Two editorial asks: 1) can we reword the Known Issues note to avoid calling out internals (no KV-cache mention), so something like "Streaming may occasionally drop partial token batches on Dedicated under heavy load; we are rolling out fixes over the next week." 2) fix three broken internal anchor links under /changelog that currently 404.

aj (DevEx): I'll update the JS snippet in the PR and run link-checker. For the anchor links — probably the new headings changed. I can add redirect anchors in the markdown.

noah (SDK): Also noticed the code block had an extra blank line that broke syntax highlighting on the site. I'll remove trailing spaces.

maria (Docs): Great — one more: can deploy-bot run a preview build so product can check the wording and the code highlighting?

deploy-bot: Preview build queued for PR #482. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai (status: building).

sophia (Product): I can eyeball the preview in ~30m. Please ensure the fallback header line is in the changelog copy.

aj (DevEx): PR updated: replaced client.generate -> client.text.generate in two spots, fixed JS snippet, added anchor redirects. Ran link-checker: 3 internal anchors fixed.

maria (Docs): Thanks AJ. Noah — can you open a tiny follow-up SDK PR if you need to change signatures in sample code, rather than altering docs to match buggy examples?

noah (SDK): Will do. Opening PR now.

maria (Docs): OK, leaving the Known Issues text as the edited non-technical line. Leaving the migration guide step that calls out exact API mapping (v1 -> v2) but tagging it as 'breaking change' with a code sample. Once deploy preview is green, I'll merge and tag release notes.

deploy-bot: Preview build completed (status: success). URL: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai — code highlighting verified (JS/Go).

sophia (Product): Looks good from my side. Approving content.

maria (Docs): Awesome — merging in 10. If anything else pops up, slack me here. :rocket:
